The survey resources are shared by the [getting-started guide](database.html) and application examples.

Connection YAML passes driver-specific arguments to DBI; this package does not define a separate configuration schema.

## Downloads

```{r downloads, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Locate the installed example directory.
resources_directory <- system.file("examples", "survey", package = "db.tools")
# Read the version used in the downloadable archive name.
resources_version <- as.character(utils::packageVersion("db.tools"))
# Describe every packaged resource.
resources_descriptions <- c(
  "README.md" = "Directory layout and usage notes.",
  "backups/numbers.sql" = "Synthetic H2 backup used by the restore guide.",
  "database.yaml" = "File-backed H2 connection with a session URL reference.",
  "postgresql.yaml" = "PostgreSQL configuration with a session password reference.",
  "queries/numbers.sql" = "Query with one bound lower limit.")
# List all files, including nested SQL resources.
resources_files <- list.files(resources_directory, recursive = TRUE)
# Show file names in the installed guide.
resources_labels <- sprintf("`%s`", resources_files)
# Add direct downloads only when building the website.
if (identical(Sys.getenv("IN_PKGDOWN"), "true")) {
  # Offer a ZIP archive preserving the examples directory.
  cat(sprintf("[Download all examples (%s, ZIP)](../db.tools-resources-%s.zip).\n\n",
    resources_version, resources_version))
  # Keep Markdown downloads distinct from generated HTML pages.
  resources_urls <- paste0("https://ultreia-io.github.io/db.tools/examples/survey/", resources_files)
  # Link each original file.
  resources_labels <- sprintf("[`%s`](%s)", resources_files, resources_urls)
}
# Render the complete resource inventory.
knitr::kable(data.frame(File = resources_labels,
  Purpose = unname(resources_descriptions[resources_files])), format = "pipe")
```

The archive name includes the package version and preserves the layout under `examples/survey/`.

## Installed resources

```{r installed-resources}
# Locate the same resources without downloading files.
system.file("examples", "survey", package = "db.tools")
```
